messages:
Rachel: Quick heads-up: my local sample-app (node & python) shows chunks reordering when auth refresh triggers during a stream. small disconnect (~200ms) and then reconnect -> some events arrive out-of-order or merged. anyone seen this with the SDKs?
Tom: ouch. which SDK versions?
Rachel: node 3.2.1, python 1.6.0. repro: start a ~8s stream, expire token at ~2s, client does auth refresh and reconnect. logs show boundary bytes split and python regex-based parser concatenates two events. node stateful parser emits two but order sometimes swaps.
Tom: sounds like two issues: parser boundary fragility + resume overlap from proxy. do we use Last-Event-ID or re-request from scratch on retry?
Rachel: we send Last-Event-ID header. proxy sometimes replies with a small overlapping tail from the old stream while upstream also resumes, so clients see duplicated suffix+prefix.
Infra-bot: streaming-proxy v2.4.2 scheduled to roll tomorrow @ 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z
Sam: proposals: 1) make parsers buffered/stateful (avoid naive split on "\n\n"), 2) add per-event monotonic seq in payload or X-Chunk-Seq header so clients can dedupe, 3) make proxy resume idempotent and avoid replay overlap.
Rachel: I prototyped a tiny change in python SDK: buffer+=chunk; while b"\n\n" in buffer: evt, buffer = buffer.split(b"\n\n", 1); handle(evt) — fixes merge in my tests.
Tom: good. also add small jittered backoff before sending Last-Event-ID to give proxy time to drain?
Sam: +1 for seq header from server; makes client-side dedupe trivial and covers flaky networks.
Rachel: opened issue: https://git.internal/redwood/issues/6821 (sse-resume-parity) and PR for python SDK patch.
Devex-bot: PR 4021 opened by rachel in repos/python-sdk (labels: devex, streaming).
Tom: can someone add a tiny Windows CI e2e that simulates 1-4 byte splits across CR/LF boundaries? we've had weird TCP segmentations there.
Rachel: will add test. assigning: proxy resume audit (infra), add seq header (platform team), node + python buffered parser updates (sdk teams).
Sam: thanks — solid triage. please post CI outcome here :thumbsup:
